title: P2PStatusView
description: P2P node status for observability. Source of truth: libp2p Swarm state + in-memory replication tracker + SQLite drain query (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request. Not persisted.

listenAddresses.description: Multiaddrs this node is listening on

relayMode.description: Relay mode this node is running in

drain.description: Drain queue state. null when DB pool or query unavailable — treat as 'data not available', NOT 'caught up'

syncPaused.description: True when the unified SyncGate holds sync for ANY reason (operator pause, wifi-only on cellular, import/bulk backpressure, drain backlog). Operators and elohim agents use this to understand node load state; syncReasons names what holds it.

syncMode.description: Operator/device sync mode from the unified SyncGate. Sticky across restart (SQLite-persisted operational state, Category C).

networkClass.description: Device-declared network class (declared via the API — never sniffed by the storage node). 'unknown' is honest and permissive: it never suppresses under wifi-only.

syncReasons.description: Reasons currently holding sync (kebab-case). Empty exactly when syncPaused is false.

dedupUniqueLen.description: D.7 dedup LRU: number of unique CIDs currently in the dedup window.

dedupTotalSeen.description: D.7 dedup LRU: cumulative insert calls (new + duplicate). Ratio (dedupTotalSeen - dedupUniqueLen) / dedupTotalSeen approximates duplication rate.

reconcilePassesTotal.description: T23 custody reconcile: total reconcile passes run since startup. CI asserts a custody reconcile pass ran without log scraping.

kicksFiredTotal.description: T23 custody reconcile: total fetch kicks fired across all passes. Non-zero confirms the reconciler emitted fetch requests for gaps.

placementGapsEmittedTotal.description: T23 custody reconcile: total placement gaps emitted across all passes.

oneOf.description: Acquisition pull-queue rollup (spec 2026-06-07-epr-acquisition-pull-queue-design §4.3-4.4). null means no local active-pin × presence reconcile has completed since process start; keep waiting, never caught-up. total=0 means a completed reconcile observed an empty desired set.

pull.description: Acquisition pull-queue rollup. null until a local active-pin × presence reconcile completes — treat as 'keep waiting', NEVER as caught up. Once non-null, total=0 is an observed empty desired set (spec §4.3).

oneOf.description: P1 projection-reconcile stream status (REA commitments converge from own conductor; peers as discovery). null when the reconcile task is not running.

caughtUp.description: This SWEEP ended: every discovered gap was healed OR exhausted its retry budget. NOT a convergence signal — use `converged`.

exhausted.description: Gaps abandoned at max_retries this sweep — healed nothing, retried no more.

converged.description: This peer holds what its peers advertised: pending==0 AND exhausted==0 AND divergentAnchor==0. Strictly stronger than caughtUp; an SLO may be offered over this field, not that one.

projectionReconcile.description: P1 projection-reconcile stream status. null when the reconcile task is not running (missing lamad HcClient / pool / disabled).

oneOf.description: Workstream D: provide-loop + re-anchor-backfill status. The provide-loop authors the replicates-content commitments whose side-projection writes the content:<reach> rows the resilience card counts; the re-anchor backfill heals content a cold-conductor seed left provenance-only (dht_anchor_hash NULL). active=false / selfCidSource='unset' is the dark-card signal.

selfCidSource.description: Where self_cid came from at boot. 'unset' means the provide-loop cannot spawn (the dark-card root cause).

active.description: True once the Slice-2b provide-loop authoring tick has spawned. False = dormant = card cannot light its content:<reach> counts.

reanchorPending.description: Content rows still lacking dht_anchor_hash after the last re-anchor sweep.

reanchorCompleted.description: Content rows re-authored (anchor stamped) this process lifetime.

reanchorFailed.description: Re-author failures (non-fatal, retried on a future boot's sweep).

reanchorCaughtUp.description: True when the re-anchor backfill ran and found no NULL-anchor rows left. False before the first run or while candidates remain.

provideLoop.description: Provide-loop + re-anchor-backfill observability. null when the holder is not wired (e.g. a P2PNode built without the builder).

irohNodeId.description: The co-resident iroh node's NodeId (64-char hex), when this node runs the iroh transport stack alongside libp2p. Additive/optional — OMITTED from the wire on a libp2p-only node (dual-stack boot is mode-exclusive today). Set at the main.rs dual block from iroh_n.node_id().
